_: An art pack: what the roster's characters look like and what they and their tiers are called. Each character's pictures are the files in her folder (claude/high.webp): a card picture per tier (chibi, middle, high, university) and an avatar for each (face-high.webp), any of .webp .png .jpg .gif. More pictures in a folder are more to choose from. Anything a pack leaves out comes from the bundled pack. See the README's 'Art packs'.
name: Academy
author: ZipZipPipe (designs), 上善无形 (DeepSeek-chan)

models._: A model's own picture, when it should not wear its tier's: "claude-opus-5-5": "claude/opus" shows claude/opus.png (or .webp, .jpg, .gif). A tier's picture works too ("gpt-6-luna": "gpt/high"), and then the card is that tier.
